mutations.label: R9H site 4 goes back to `[^}]+`: the HARD gate returns. A page declaring the framework's own shape form fails the contract check against a contract that DOES hold the endpoint, `_contract_misses` sets ok=False, and the page can never reach `implemented` however much anyone builds. r46 carried 8 of these.

R9I site 3 goes back to `[^}]+`. `register_endpoint` refuses the empty form, so this is a no-op on today's data and the CORPUS cannot see it -- only the stub in `test_registered_paths_normalises_the_endpoint_side`, which feeds an endpoint carrying `{}` directly, can. That test exists because the two halves of one comparison drifting apart is how the original mismatch arose.

R9J CONTROL, expected CAUGHT: the METHOD is dropped from the contract comparison, so `POST /api/titles/{}/episodes` matches a contract that only registered the GET. Normalising the path must not turn this check into a rubber stamp, and the wrong-method case is what refuses it.
